origin.description: Return only the neighbor distances from get.knn.
origin.details: Euclidean distances are the square root of the squared distance stored in the queue. CR returns 1 - x'y.
origin.example: knn.dist of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=5, default kd_tree

translation.description: knn_dist returns the Euclidean distances from get_knn.
translation.details: Euclidean distances are the square root of the squared distance stored in the queue. CR returns 1 - x'y.
translation.example: knn.dist of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=5, default kd_tree
